links.comparator_used: Unprompted LLM responses (default prompt without reading-level instruction)
links.outcome: Reading level of patient-facing responses when prompted for a grade 8 level
links.effect: Chatbots could not reach grade 8 when prompted. Average Flesch-Kincaid reading level was grade 12.9 (SD 2.1). Overall information quality (DISCERN) rose from moderate to high with prompting, but the abstract does not say that prompt specified reading level.
links.tradeoff: Citations were appropriate only 42.5% of the time.
links.quote: Chatbots were unable to communicate at a grade 8 reading level when prompted, and their citations were appropriate only 42.5% of the time.
